messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=inference-runtime region=us-west2 metric=tail_latency_99p value=1200ms threshold=700ms — triggering page to eng-oncall at 2415001234 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Autoscales/Autoscheduler shows continuous-batching queue depth high; recent deploy? no recent user deploys.
samir_oncall: on it. paging details? who is on shift? :wave:
alex_s: samir — hi, I saw this on the dashboard. 99p latency up across text-gen models. suspect continuous batching window grew because of traffic pattern change (lots of small requests).
maria_k: adding context: Kinesis/ingress shows 3x increase in bursty short-requests at 2415001200-2415001220. average prompt length ~50 tokens. batching algorithm currently targets batch_window_ms=200 and min_batch_size=8.
jamie_r: linking chart: https://redwood.internal/metrics/qt?panel=batching+shapes&from=2415001000&to=2415001400 :eyes:
samir_oncall: OK. what's the quick mitigation that reduces p99? We can either shrink batch window (latency up -> reduce batching) or fall back to non-continuous batching mode (disable continuous batching). Both reduce throughput. any customer impact?
alex_s: tradeoff: set batch_window_ms=50 & min_batch_size=2 reduces p99 but throughput drops ~25%. Alternate is disable continuous batching for affected model family which drops throughput ~40% but simpler.
maria_k: I can push live config change to runtime via the internal admin API. suggestion: apply targeted change for model-group "gptx-medium" in us-west2 first.
product-lead: please prioritize minimal customer impact. if we need to throttle non-critical tenants that's also an option. Tell me expected customer-visible risk.
tasha_support: I can pre-draft msgs for customers above SLA tier. Which tenants are likely to see throttles?
alex_s: topline: change batch_window_ms->50 on gptx-medium in us-west2, and enable per-tenant priority shaping to keep enterprise tenants at current qps. small clients get shaped to preserve SLO for critical customers.
maria_k: running dry-run command to update config (no commit):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://admin-internal.redwood/v1/runtime/configs/apply-dryrun \ 
  -d '{"scope":"model_group:gptx-medium","region":"us-west2","overrides": {"batch_window_ms":50,"min_batch_size":2}}'
```
(maria_k edits after dry-run) dry-run OK, checks passed: no schema errors, estimated p99 delta -420ms, throughput -22%.
samir_oncall: proceed with targeted apply. maria, also add a traffic-shaper rule: priority_tier for orgs [org-12, org-99] = high. others = best-effort with soft-qps 60.
maria_k: applying live change now. executing:
```
# apply config and shaping for us-west2 gptx-medium
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://admin-internal.redwood/v1/runtime/configs/apply \ 
  -d '{"scope":"model_group:gptx-medium","region":"us-west2","overrides": {"batch_window_ms":50,"min_batch_size":2},"traffic_shaper": {"priority_overrides":[{"org":"org-12","tier":"high"},{"org":"org-99","tier":"high"}],"soft_qps":60}}'
```
maria_k: apply returned 202 accepted, change-id=chg_20240301_4932.
deploy-bot: config-change chg_20240301_4932 applied to 12 hosts in us-west2 for scope model_group:gptx-medium.
jamie_r: watching metrics now. loading p99 panel...
(1m) jamie_r: p99 dropping from 1200ms -> 480ms. good sign.
(3m) alex_s: saw client-side complaints earlier about timeouts; that should reduce now.
tasha_support: notifying top customers now. draft posted to #customer-notify for review. (cc product-lead)
product-lead: approved. include ETA for rollback if issues.
samir_oncall: keep eyes on CPU/GPU utilization — smaller batches may increase per-token overhead. maria, any spike?
maria_k: GPU util up ~10% on the pool, within capacity. no errors thrown.
jamie_r: p50 unchanged, p95 down ~200ms, p99 down ~700ms. throughput reduced ~20% as expected. traffic shaping has started soft-shaping low-priority orgs.
(10m) incident-bot: NOTE: rate_limit_events increased for some orgs in us-west2 after shaping. counts: org-207 ~340 blocks/min.
tasha_support: pinging org-207 ops team with workaround and ETA.
alex_s: we should consider a secondary mitigation: enable per-model quantized variant for small-prompts to reduce latency at similar throughput. but that needs ops signoff, not immediate.
product-lead: track that as follow-up action item. want postmortem and decision on whether to change default batch_window_ms.
samir_oncall: for now, mitigation succeeded. i'm going to create a short incident note and hand off to next on-call in 30m. if p99 stays <750ms and error rate stable, we'll keep change for 2 hours then revert gradually.
maria_k: setting scheduled revert in 2h (auto-revert unless extended): revert_chg=chg_20240301_4932 at 2415008434 unless incident extended.
jamie_r: logging: screenshots and snapshots saved to /incidents/2415001234/batching-mitigation.
tasha_support: customer-notify sent to 4 tenants; responses expected. putting templates into #customer-comm-templates.
(28m) alex_s: quick note: runbook step executed: "reduce batch window" -> checked. good candidate for automating in future when burst-detection triggers auto-reduce.
samir_oncall: starting handoff notes: summary, mitigation, change-id, rollback schedule, affected orgs, metrics links. next oncall @ 2415002000 is jamie_r. tagging them.
jamie_r: ack, will monitor until revert. closing thread in 2h unless new alerts. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: RESOLVED: p99 latency returned below threshold for 30s window. incident marked mitigated at 2415001899.
